name: Courtney Parella
current_role: Deputy Assistant Secretary for Public Affairs, U.S. Department of Labor (since March 2025)
summary: Courtney Parella is a deputy assistant secretary in the Labor Department’s Office of Public Affairs, named in March 2025, and has been a media contact on the department’s announcements. The office is led by David O’Brien.
